rationale: Secondary missions are up to half the points on the table, and the AI has positional terms for them (zone bonuses, spread, enemy-zone push, kill proximity). This exam does not assert which secondary is drawn — that is the deck's business — it asserts the machinery is LIVE: at least one movement candidate in the phase carries a non-zero secondary term. A silent regression here would leave the AI playing primary-only while the log still claimed otherwise.

assert.name: a movement candidate carries a non-zero secondary term
